title: Free Boundary Regularity for Non-Convex Fully Nonlinear Alt-Phillips Problems
summary: This paper studies the fully nonlinear Alt-Phillips free boundary problem \begin{equation} F(D^2u) = u^γχ_{\{u>0\}}, \end{equation} for $γ\in (-1/3,1)$ without any convexity assumption on $F$. We establish that flat free boundaries are smooth. This result is new even for the fully nonlinear obstacle problem when $γ= 0$. Our approach is based on a partial hodograph transform, which converts the free boundary into a fixed boundary and produces a fully nonlinear degenerate equation.
